title: Python Control
taskStreamClosed: AI event connection ended or was interrupted. Check the actual task; no new request is started automatically.
taskWaiting: Waiting for actual model events. Queued does not mean completed.
boundary: Real CPython runs in a separate WASI process. Only scoped Actions can access this project. Host files and arbitrary networking are unavailable; important changes still require approval.
draft: Allow reversible drafts; confirm important actions
readSettings: Read this project’s character, world and author notes
sharedRegistry: Shared by both personas, Python and Codex MCP
noHistory: No runs yet. Choose an example or write a script.
grantHelp: Advanced: create a 15-minute grant to use the same SDK from external Python. It is scoped to this project and persona. Do not share the token; it is not saved in scripts, logs or backups.
createGrant: Create grant and show connection code
noOutput: Standard output, errors and actual Action receipts appear here.
readApproved: Continue with a result-reading script; do not regenerate
scopeChanged: Project or task changed; action cancelled
bridgeReconnect: Control connection interrupted; reconnecting without replaying completed Actions.
directorBoundary: Load the read-only analysis script, then explicitly Run. Only this candidate version is handed off; no extra AI request or manuscript change. Return and hand off again if it changes.
replaceScript: Replace the current unsaved script? Save it first if needed.
analysisReturnBoundary: Save actual output and candidate provenance as an author note. Never automatically edits prose or sends it to a model.
saveAnalysisReturn: Save analysis and return to Director
analysisSaved: Analysis saved as an author-only note.
